title: Amethyst never ending pit with holographic grid/sacred geometry
content: Has anyone seen this pit before it glows a radiant amethyst purple color. You can see the crystal formations as you peer down and a holographic grid as you peer down You want to jump in because it feels like something you need to do to travel to another dimension but you are slightly intimidated. I’ve been trying to find it again because I was to scared to jump in.
